name: agentpostoffice-monorepo
description: Cloudflare-native, self-hosted email inboxes for agents

scripts.build: npm run openapi:check && npm --workspace @agentpostoffice/sieve run build && npm --workspace @agentpostoffice/client run build && npm --workspace @agentpostoffice/cli run build && npm --workspace @agentpostoffice/mcp run build && npm --workspace @agentpostoffice/worker run build
scripts.check: npm --workspace @agentpostoffice/sieve run build && npm --workspace @agentpostoffice/client run build && npm run check --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json && npm run openapi:lint && npm run openapi:check
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:worker
scripts.test:worker: vitest run --config packages/worker/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/worker/vitest.pre0005.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/worker/vitest.upgrade0007.config.ts && vitest run --config packages/worker/vitest.upgrade0008.config.ts
